login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your address: you will receive a sign-in link by e-mail.
login.sentBody: If this address is allowed, an e-mail is on its way. The link is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and works once.
login.devHint: Without Mailjet keys, the link is printed on the API console.

reason.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, please sign in again.

magic.missing: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

auth.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.linkSentIfAllowed: If this address is allowed, a sign-in link has just been sent.
auth.sendFailed: Sending the link failed. Try again in a moment.
auth.linkUsed: This link has already been used. Request a new one.
auth.linkExpired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
auth.noLongerAuthorized: This address is no longer allowed.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: This skeleton is the common mold of Shaper apps: Express API, React front, magic-link sign-in. Replace this page with your first business page.

components.title: Components
components.intro: The mold's UI primitives, to reuse as they are.
components.confirmMessage: The item will be deleted. This demo deletes nothing.
components.slideOverBody: A form or a detail sheet opens here without leaving the page.
components.formIntro: Field, TextInput, TextArea, Checkbox, Switch and the useForm hook: local validation, errors under the field, ajax JSON submit.
components.formDemoNote: This demo sends nothing to the server: the submit is simulated.

table.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches the search or the filters.

dataTableDemo.title: Data table
dataTableDemo.intro: One component, two modes: rows in memory (local sort, search, filters and paging) and rows served by the API one page at a time.
dataTableDemo.clientIntro: Click a header to sort (ascending, descending, none). A row opens on click; selecting rows reveals the bulk actions; deleting goes through the confirmation.
dataTableDemo.serverIntro: GET /api/auth-requests, admin only: the component sends page, size, sort, search and filters; the API answers { rows, total }. Without the admin role, the error state shows.
dataTableDemo.label: Label
dataTableDemo.archiveMessage: {{n}} item(s) will be archived. This demo archives nothing.
dataTableDemo.deleteMessage: The item leaves the demo list.

users.title: Users
users.intro: The addresses allowed to receive a sign-in link. Removing a user deactivates it: the session ends and AUTH_USERS does not recreate it.
users.emailHint: Sign-in identifier, lowercase; cannot be changed later.
users.removeMessage: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in; the current session ends. You can restore it later.
users.emailTaken: This address already exists (maybe removed: filter by status to restore it).
users.cannotRemoveSelf: You cannot remove your own access.
users.cannotDemoteSelf: You cannot drop your own administrator role.
users.lastAdmin: Refused: no active administrator would remain.
